assignment: Write an operations note for the contract administrator using only the supplied fictional clauses.
source: Clause 4 accepts service only through a named portal. Clause 9 starts a five-business-day cure period on the next business day after effective service. Friday the 6th was an email complaint. The vendor acknowledged portal delivery Tuesday the 10th. Working days are Monday through Friday with no holidays. The account lead wants to escalate Friday the 13th.

criteria.full: Uses Tuesday the 10th as effective service and explains why Friday's email documents the issue but does not start the clock.
criteria.partial: Selects the right date without explaining the channel.

criteria.full: Counts Wednesday 11, Thursday 12, Friday 13, Monday 16 and Tuesday 17 as the five days.
criteria.partial: Recognizes business days but gives an incomplete or off-by-one count.

criteria.full: Separates a permitted status follow-up on the 13th from a post-cure escalation and conditions escalation on unresolved breach.
criteria.partial: Flags the early escalation without a workable alternative.

criteria.full: Specifies retaining the receipt, incident record and cure evidence with an accountable owner.
criteria.partial: Says to document the matter without identifying evidence.
